:::writing{variant="social_post" id="72914"}
There are parts of my story I’ve stayed quiet about… but not anymore.

A year and a half ago, my life changed in a way I never could have imagined. What was done to me didn’t just leave emotional scars… it left physical ones too. Ones I’ve been living with every single day.

This week, in God’s perfect timing, I finally had neck surgery to repair the damage.

For the last year and a half, I’ve lived in pain. The kind of pain that doesn’t just go away. The kind that shows up when you try to sleep, when you try to work, when you’re just trying to exist. And still… I kept going.

Not because it was easy.  
But because I had to.

I had a son to show up for.  
A life to rebuild.  
A version of me I refused to lose.

And to those who chose to listen to lies, to judge without knowing the truth… just know this:

I didn’t leave because I wanted to.  
I left because I had to.

I left to survive.  
I left to heal.  
I left to protect what was left of me.

And now… I see it all so clearly.

God didn’t just carry me through the pain… He led me out of it.

Post-divorce, I am happier than I’ve ever been. I am in a safe, loving relationship with a man who would never lay a hand on me, who protects my peace instead of disturbing it, and who reminds me every day what real love is supposed to feel like.

This surgery is not the end of my story… it’s part of my comeback.

So if you’ve ever questioned my strength, my choices, or my silence… just know you were never given the full story.

But I lived it.

And I’m still rising. 🔥
:::
